fingerprint_contract: Remove the top-level attestation_fingerprint field, canonicalize with systematic_trading_lab.fingerprints.canonical_json, and take SHA-256 of those UTF-8 bytes.

fixed_inherited_constraints.candidate_envelope: At most nine parents formed from exactly three fixed post-publication completed-bar observation horizons crossed with exactly three fixed joint positive reaction floors.
fixed_inherited_constraints.chronology: Use only the five exposed periods and context-only-session rule bound by the autonomous program. Complete a stage before reading merit and never adapt from partial results.
fixed_inherited_constraints.data: Use only the program-bound exposed SPY and QQQ five-minute OHLCV dataset IDs plus the allowed metadata-only Federal Reserve artifacts. Do not acquire price or volume data.
fixed_inherited_constraints.execution: Long-only, completed-bar-only, state changes only, no leverage, one joint half-weight SPY/QQQ entry per eligible session, no reentry, flat at close, Normal delay one bar, diagnostic zero cost only, and the program-bound cost model.
fixed_inherited_constraints.publication_time: Exactly 14:00 America/New_York on a full 78-bar XNYS session; publication bar index 54 becomes observable only when it completes at 14:05.
fixed_inherited_constraints.stop_boundary: Stop after a nonempty all-gate cohort or Campaign 3 terminal closeout. Campaign 4 is prohibited. No controlled range is currently eligible.

calendar_and_class_acceptance: Independently accept or reject the exhaustive 15-event calendar as a whole after checking both eligible publication classes, every period count, class count, 14:00 local-time rule, full-session rule, uniqueness, and the frozen sample floor.
State whether policy statements and meeting minutes may share one causal contract. Do not select a class, date, period, or subset from market behavior.
If any calendar or class requirement fails, prescribe terminal pre-execution closure without widening, substitution, or market-data access.
causal_signal_and_execution: Choose the exact reaction-return formula, price fields, reference index, terminal index for each horizon, units, rounding rule, and strict or inclusive threshold comparisons.
Choose exactly three post-publication observation horizons and exactly three positive reaction floors without using or trying to reconstruct the rejected draft.

Define the joint SPY/QQQ activation rule, exact decision timestamp, Normal entry-fill index, stress-delay fill indices, missed-entry rule, close-safe exit decision and fill indices, and flat-at-close failure behavior.
Define deterministic candidate IDs, the complete three-by-three parent grid, no-signal reasons, and the pre-entry trace fields that may be retained without later returns.
gates_and_selection: Choose every exact discovery, walk-forward, stress, delay, and immediate-neighbor gate and threshold before any market bars or results are read.

Cover Normal and diagnostic zero-cost return, activity, event count, round trips, average gross trade edge, cost-to-gross-profit, drawdown, chronological stability, execution delay, accounting, and signal-trace equality wherever defined.
Choose disqualifying concentration metrics and thresholds for session, period, publication class, and event identity; do not claim diversification from mechanical joint SPY/QQQ half weights.
Choose exact complete-pair requirements, candidate caps, selection order, simultaneous cohort rule, undefined-metric action, and all-gate terminal disposition.
neighbor_graph_and_budget: Choose the exact symmetric immediate-neighbor graph for both axes, including perturbation values, boundary behavior, candidate IDs, and at most four neighbors for the one serious-candidate cap.

Choose every stage scenario and exact prospective run count. Prove the arithmetic for discovery, walk-forward, stress and delay, neighbors, and the total at or below 90 without transferring unused Campaign 1 or Campaign 2 capacity.
State which later stages open only after a complete prior-stage screen and how ties are resolved without result-driven discretion.
failure_and_stop_rules: Choose exact dispositions for missing or duplicate events, incomplete sessions, missing causal bars, data or hash mismatch, invalid thresholds, undefined metrics, deterministic candidate failure, publication conflict, partial-stage output, and stale source binding.

Preserve the program's exact expired-no-result infrastructure retry boundary and three-attempt ceiling; no deterministic data, candidate, control, or publication failure may be relabeled as infrastructure.
Keep all authority false, prohibit protected and broker state, and prescribe cross-campaign synthesis plus the frozen three-campaign stop after an empty Campaign 3.

input_control.committed_packet_rule: The architect may begin only after this attestation and all allowed inputs are available together at one pushed commit; the assignment must bind that commit and this file's SHA-256.
input_control.permitted_read_scope: This attestation and only the six allowed_inputs paths at their exact SHA-256 values.
input_control.unlisted_input_rule: Do not read, search, infer from, or receive any unlisted repository path, external source, tool history, prior agent output, or conversation context.

isolation_attestation.coordinator_role: The coordinator may enforce inherited program controls and mechanically encode the returned design, but is ineligible to select, suggest, rank, or alter replacement scientific or execution choices.
isolation_attestation.planner_history: fresh architect with no inherited conversation turns
prohibited_inputs: the rejected draft at config/research/intraday-fed-policy-absorption-001-plan-v1.json or any copy, diff, hash reversal, deleted bytes, tool output, or description of its choices
Federal Reserve release bodies, decisions, votes, projections, implementation notes, surprises, or revisions beyond the allowed metadata
market bars, prices, returns, strategy results, result summaries, reports, attempt databases, reservations, or any .trading-lab path
June 2026, Intraday V3 A/B/C, daily 2018-2019, protected results, PAPER or broker state, strategic-allocation-21, or live data
prior conversation history or guidance from any prior plan author or reviewer
isolation_attestation.root_exposure_recorded: The coordinator has seen prohibited release-body text and the rejected draft's choices, so only the isolated architect may originate replacement choices.

output_contract.deliverable: One self-contained exact replacement-design recommendation, not a menu of alternatives and not a repository edit.
output_contract.encoding_rule: The coordinator must encode the recommendation without changing its choices, bind the final plan to this attestation and source commit, then obtain a fresh independent finding-free plan and calendar review before implementation or any market-data read.
output_contract.rationale_rule: Give non-result-derived causal, sample-size, cost, and close-safety reasons for every exact numerical choice.
output_contract.rejection_rule: If the allowed evidence cannot support a valid plan, return a terminal pre-execution rejection with exact reasons instead of filling gaps from outside sources.

exact failure, terminal, authority, and protected-boundary rules
